title: Server backups
intro: Back up the known application database and private files to the dedicated destination from environment settings.
authority: Only server administrators can use this action. It is separate from workspace exports and backups of notes on this device.
reviewed: Current settings and job status have been reviewed.
requesting: Confirming acceptance of the backup request…
accepted: The request was accepted. Acceptance does not mean backup completion or a successful restore drill.
uncertain: Acceptance could not be confirmed. The same request is retained. Automatic resubmission and new requests are stopped.
denied: Sign in as a verified server administrator.
accountChanged: The account changed or expired. No further request was sent.
accessChanged: Server administrator access could not be confirmed. Actions have stopped.
unavailable: Backups are unavailable. Review environment settings and server state.
invalidResponse: The response could not be verified. The request is retained and new requests are stopped.
journalUnavailable: The request cannot be retained in this tab, so it will not be sent. Review browser storage settings.
journalInvalid: The previous request record could not be verified. New requests are stopped. An administrator should review the job list.
destinationChanged: The previously reviewed destination differs from the current one. This request will not be resent. Review environment settings and jobs.
scopeAccounts: Accounts, password hashes, encrypted OAuth information, memberships and access permissions
scopeContent: Known application data: saved pages, collections, history, comments, preferences and server-saved prototype notes
scopeFiles: Private files referenced by the database, including attachments
excludeEnvironment: Environment files, authentication secrets, encryption keys and destination credentials
excludeDevice: Notes and files stored only on this device
keyBoundary: Keep the encryption key, authentication secret and environment settings needed for restore separately and securely.
configHint: Settings are managed in the environment file. This screen does not change destinations or keys.
noAutoDelete: Automatic deletion is disabled. Files are not automatically deleted when the retention period passes.
destinationNone: No dedicated backup destination is configured.
destinationHint: Backups are sent to this dedicated destination, separately from normal attachment storage.
transform0: Login sessions, verification/reset/OAuth challenges, external API tokens and rate-limit state are discarded.
transform1: Pending invitations, mail and webhook deliveries are cancelled; webhook approvals and subscriptions are stopped. External actions are never resent automatically.
transform2: Uncommitted uploads, public links and collaboration state are discarded. Restored revisions are advanced.
transform3: Account IDs, password hashes, encrypted OAuth information, memberships, access rules, saved content, history, comments and preferences are retained.
transform4: Attachment references are remapped to newly verified files at the restore destination.
consent: I reviewed sending the database information and private files above to the displayed dedicated destination.
confirmTitle: Request a backup to this destination?
confirmHint: The database includes sensitive information such as password hashes and encrypted OAuth data. The server processes it after acceptance.
heldHint: This tab retains the same request. Reviewing status alone does not resubmit it.
retryHint: Use the same reference, destination and scope. If it was not accepted before, this request will be accepted now. No different request is created.
jobsHint: Acceptance, completed storage and restore testing are separate. Completion here does not mean a restore drill succeeded.
completeBoundary: The encrypted archive was stored and verified. A restore drill is still a separate task.
errorGeneric: The job could not complete. An administrator should review the destination and job status.
errorChecksum: Data integrity could not be verified. This is not a completed backup.
errorTooLarge: The data exceeds the backup limits.
errorSource: The source database or file could not be verified.
errorDestination: The dedicated destination could not store the backup.
sessionOnly: Unconfirmed request details are retained in this account’s tab storage. A new request is never created automatically.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
cleanupSafety: Delete only files in the dedicated backup destination that match this app's creation records. Keep the latest good archive, active backups/restores and unknown files.
cleanupQuiescence: Before enabling cleanup, stop older app versions, restores in other environments and manual archive operations. Upgrade all readers and writers to the supported current version.
cleanupLocks: Protect uncertain operations and remaining locks. Never take over a lock just because time has passed. Untracked failed artifacts from older versions are not deleted automatically.
cleanupDisabled: Automatic cleanup is disabled. Dedicated environment settings and administrator approval are required.
cleanupSchemaRequired: The cleanup schema is missing. Explicitly apply backup:migrate on Node or migration 0005 on D1, then restart. Normal backups continue.
cleanupActive: Periodically clean expired artifacts under the approved retention policy.
cleanupAwaitingApproval: Cleanup is configured but awaits an administrator's review and approval.
cleanupReviewed: Review the destination, deletion candidates and protected archive.
cleanupNone: No current candidates. Once approved, future artifacts matching the same policy are also eligible.
cleanupOngoingConsent: I reviewed this destination and policy and approve automatic cleanup of current and future expired artifacts.
cleanupQuiescenceConsent: I stopped older versions, restores in other environments and manual operations, and upgraded all readers and writers to the supported version.
cleanupEnabled: Cleanup policy approved. Acceptance does not mean deletion is complete.
cleanupStopHint: Stop new deletions. A single deletion that has already started cannot be undone.
cleanupUncertain: The outcome is unknown. No automatic retry will run. Refresh to inspect the current approval and job state.
cleanupBlockedHint: Stopped while keeping the archive protected. An operator must inspect the operation and destination. Do not force-take locks by age.
cleanupArtifactRemoved: This archive was removed by an approved cleanup. Its creation record is retained.
